evidence.sentence: The NDC target of 65% emissions reduction economy-wide, compared to 1990 level, is achievable for all sectors of the economy under the following conditions: - preserving access to foreign markets of key trade partners, - stable and predictable trade policy and the absence of restrictions and barriers from the Annex I Parties to UNFCCC and other countries, which might introduce similar restrictions and barriers, - access to financing for climate modernization projects from the developed countries, private sector, international financial institutions and other donors.
In contrast, the NDC predicts a 6.6% reduction of GHG emissions in 2030 compared to the current level (2019).

Gases covered: all GHGs not controlled by the Montreal Protocol - Carbon Dioxide (CO2), Methane Sectors, gases, categories (CH4), Nitrous Oxide (N2O), Hydrofluorocarbons and pools covered by the (HFCs), Perfluorocarbons (PFCs), Sulphur nationally determined Hexafluoride (SF6), Nitrogen Trifluoride (NF3); contribution, including, as applicable, consistent with Economic sectors covered: energy; industrial Intergovernmental Panel on processes and product use; agriculture, land use, Climate Change (IPCC) land-use change and forestry; waste; guidelines Percentage of GHG emissions covered: 100 %.

series.$note: series.observed holds several sources and must not be read as one curve. DS-35: All greenhouse gases including land-use change, GWP100 (OWID, from Climate Watch / PIK), from 1990. DS-02: Asset-level observed emissions, CO₂e GWP100 (Climate TRACE); land use accounted differently from OWID, 2015-2025. DS-40: Total GHG emissions including LULUCF/LUCF exactly as the Party submitted them to the UNFCCC, on that Party’s own reporting guidelines and GWP set (UNFCCC Data Interface, snapshot of 2024-07-05). Non-Annex I Parties report only the years their national communications cover, and the figure is negative where reported removals exceed reported emissions. Points from an NDC document are that document's own inventory basis. The same year can appear more than once with different values; R3 keeps them side by side and never averages them.

derived.$note: Trend: least-squares slope over 35 observed years (1990-2024) from DS-35, compared against the DS-06-NDC target of 315.04 MtCO₂e by 2030. The two are not necessarily on the same inventory scope, see series.$note. The target tonnage is derived here, not quoted: 65% below DS-35's 1990 value of 900.113 MtCO₂e. The document states the percentage; the level it is applied to comes from DS-35, on DS-35's inventory scope, which is not necessarily the document's.
derived.$reason: the target (315.04 MtCO₂e) is above the latest observed level (222.882 MtCO₂e), so no cut is required today. Carried forward at the observed -12.50 MtCO₂e/yr, 2030 projects 147.9 MtCO₂e, still under it.

title.text: 4. Structured summary: Tracking progress made in implementing and achieving the NDC under Article 4 of the Paris Agreement a

progress.text: Ukraine is on track to reach the target defined by Ukraine's NDC. Russia's armed aggression and full-scale invasion caused abrupt decline in GHG emissions. Recovery of Ukraine's economy and renewal of destroyed infrastructure may cause some increase of GHG emissions. However it will not exceed the target of Ukraine's NDC.

target_text.text: Economy-wide net domestic reduction of 65 % in GHG emissions by 2030 compared to 1990. By 2030 Ukraine plans to create a baseline for adaptation to climate change in order to increase resilience and reduce vulnerability to climate change, as foresee in Article 7 of the Paris Agreement. Economy-wide absolute emission reduction.

reference_text.text: Base year value is equal to 100% of economy-wide net GHG emissions in Ukraine, excluding bunker fuels and indirect CO2 and N2O

emissions_profile.$note: Headline totals are OWID only. OWID's CO₂ sub-totals are fossil/industrial CO₂ by fuel, not a full sectoral GHG breakdown, and do not sum to total_mtco2e. DS-05's rows are non-CO₂ gases only and are not comparable with the others; that is also why DS-05 is absent from series.observed, where a shorter curve would read as a disagreement rather than a difference of scope. by_source carries each source whole.

verdict.text: Ukraine pledges a 65% reduction by 2030 against 1990 baseline (condition not read). The registry's current submission for this Party is Second NDC, filed 2025-11-11. It was read and refused, so the figure above comes from the First NDC (2021). 78 observed values are loaded from DS-02 (11), DS-35 (35), DS-40 (32). For 2024 the sources disagree: DS-02 249.2 MtCO₂e, DS-35 222.9 MtCO₂e. They are on different inventory scopes and the engine does not reconcile them. On the observed trend the target is already met. Both figures are on DS-35's inventory: the document's percentage applied to DS-35's 1990 level, not the document's own. It submitted BTR1. 4 of 8 components have been confirmed in the document; the rest are unparsed, which is not a finding against the country. ND-GAIN scores it 53.5 for 2024. In the first NDC round, WRI's CAIT assessment recorded: Will not exceed 60% of 1990 GHG emissions level in 2030 It was classed unconditional. That is a 2016 assessment of an earlier submission, not the target above. Projected warming for 2080-2099 against 1995-2014 ranges from +1.63°C under SSP1-2.6 to +5.48°C under SSP5-8.5. These are model runs, not observations.
